; docformat = 'rst' ;+ ; Computes analytical solution to a parabolic fit. ; ; :Categories: ; ; SST pipeline ; ; ; :Author: ; ; Jaime de la Cruz Rodriguez (ITA-UiO 2011) ; ; ; :Returns: ; ; Returns the 3 coefficients of the parabola: y = cf[0] + cf[1] * x ; + cf[2] * x^2 ; ; :Params: ; ; x : in, type=array ; ; X values to fit. ; ; y : in, type=array ; ; Y values to fit. ; ; :History: ; ; 2017-11-16 : MGL. Import parab_fit.pro from Jaime. ; ; ;- function red_parab_fit, x, y cf = fltarr(3) d = x[0] e = x[1] f = x[2] yd = y[0] ye = y[1] yf = y[2] cf[1] = ((yf - yd) - (f^2. - d^2.) * ((ye - yd) / (e^2. - d^2.)))/$ ((f - d) - (f^2. - d^2.) * ((e - d) / (e^2. - d^2.))) cf[2] = ((ye - yd) - cf[1] * (e - d)) / (e^2.0 - d^2.0) cf[0] = yd - cf[1] * d - cf[2] * d^2.0 return, cf end
